messages:
maya: Quick sync — compiling the FINAL launch gates for the combined SOC2+ISO audit next Wed. I need a crisp acceptance checklist that covers product, infra, and ops capacity. Major asks: BYOK handshake, audit-log exports, legal-hold flow, retention SLAs per region, evidence export performance. Who can own items?
kevin: I can own infra + capacity numbers. We need answers on GPU/IO for export jobs and nightly indexing.
andrew: Happy to own product acceptance (end-to-end proof that audit logs capture user-level events + schema). Do we have a single canonical event schema?
leigh: Legal wants: 1) documented legal-hold override path, 2) immutable evidence packaging format, 3) retention exceptions audit trail. CC: @legal-team for sign-off.
legal-team: Confirming we need: legal hold TTL = infinite until release, detailed chain-of-custody metadata, and an export manifest per request. Also need export redaction checklist before handing to customers.
maya: Draft acceptance checklist (WIP) — please react with :thumbsup: if OK or reply with edits. MUST-HAVES (block release):
- BYOK/KMS handshake validated (key exchange + access logs) across all target regions
- Audit log ingestion: 100% of auth/crypto/keystore ops instrumented (sampling QA done)
- Evidence export: end-to-end test that produces PKCS#7 signed package + manifest
- Retention policy enforced: indexed logs queryable <=5s P95 for 30 days; cold-archive retrieval latency documented
- Legal-hold: ability to mark tenant data immutable and prevent purge; release workflow + audit trail
- Rollback/fallback: automated routing to fallback model variant when compliance routes fail
- Ops capacity: sustained concurrent export jobs = 10 per region without >10% SLA burnout
NICE-TO-HAVES (not blocking):
- Export streaming (chunked) for >10GB exports
- Differential retention views in console
- Granular key-rotation drill in staging
kevin: Infrastructure notes — we ran load sims. For 10 concurrent exports per region we need: 8 x m6i.8xlarge equivalents for indexing + 2x heavy IO nodes for packaging (est). If legal will accept staged export (night window) we can reduce peak by 40%.
andrew: Event schema: adding canonical field `actor_id` + `action_context` + `keystore_key_id`. Product test to include a sample trace for a BYOK decrypt + evidence export. Example test assertion: `manifest.signature_verified == true`
leigh: Legal asked for a pre-release checklist we can hand to customer success. Make sure export manifest includes: requestor id, legal reference id, time range, retention flags, key fingerprints.
ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled blackout for exports on 2026-04-01 02:00-03:00 UTC (maintenance). All export jobs during that window will be queued.
maya: Two open questions before finalizing: 1) Do we require key escrow for SOC2+ISO or is BYOK + KMS audit logs sufficient? 2) What is the SLA for evidence export delivery to customer (target)?
legal-team: Escrow is not required by default; it is a contractual option. For audit we need an escrow policy doc and customer-facing option. SLA: propose 72 hours for large (>50GB) exports, 24 hours for <50GB.
andrew: Product suggests: target SLA 24 hours for typical exports, 72 for large. We'll add automated progress reporting endpoint: `GET /exports/{id}/status` returning `{"percent_complete":"int","eta":"ISO8601"}`
kevin: Ops capacity + acceptance: can commit to 24h SLA if we gate release to regions with export capacity and limit concurrent by default to 5 per region (soft-limit). We can scale later via autoscaling policy.
maya: OK — next steps: Kevin to post capacity doc + cost delta by EOD, Andrew to attach sample event trace and automated test, Legal to draft escrow option blurb, Leigh to produce customer CS checklist. I'll collate and produce final gate doc by tomorrow morning. :eyes:
leigh: I’ll produce the CS checklist and short script for customers to validate exported packages.
kevin: Posting infra doc in #eng-infra later today.
andrew: I’ll add the test to the CI matrix and tag `compliance/audit-run`
maya: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers DM me — otherwise I’ll mark this thread as the canonical gating checklist. :thumbsup:
